input.K: intrinsics at the input size, pixel-edge convention (u spans [u, u+1))
input.R: camera->robot rotation; camera axes x right, y down, z forward
input.t: camera position in the robot frame (m): robot frame x right, y up, z forward, origin on the ground under the robot

outputs.occ_logit: obstacle (rigid height >= step) logit; trained with pos_weight 3
outputs.vis_logit: cell observed by the camera, logit
outputs.elev: terrain elevation relative to the ground under the robot (m)
